Since their first publication by Fortin [29] and by Crouzeix & Raviart [23], they have been substantially simplified and generalized by a number of authors. We shall study here contributions by Bernardi & Raugel [10], Fortin [30], Johnson & Pitkaranta [46], Mansfield [56] and Boland & Nicolaides [12]. The situation and notations are those of Section 1.3.
